title: UNIQON Billing Pro • Build 297 (Google Drive Desktop OAuth2 & Silent Cloud Auto-Sync, Tap-to-Edit Bill No)
highlights: Google Drive Cloud Auto-Backup on Windows: Desktop EXE now supports 1-click Google Account sign-in via browser loopback with automatic token persistence.
Silent Cloud Auto-Sync on Desktop: Backups automatically upload silently to Google Drive in the background whenever bills are saved and on app exit.
Tap-to-Edit Bill Number on Mobile: Users can now tap directly on the Bill No on mobile to correct or customize invoice numbers (e.g. change 005354 to 000535).
Invoice Settings Counter Fix: Setting the next bill number in Settings > Invoice Settings now strictly respects the owner's choice and will not revert back to older high numbers.
Default Admin Auto-Prefill: Username field is automatically pre-filled with 'admin' so customers never wonder what their username is.
1-Click Continue as Admin: When App Lock is turned OFF in Settings, a single tap on 'Continue as Admin' opens the software without demanding any password.
fixes: Added OAuth 2.0 loopback client (auth_io) to GoogleDriveBackupService for Windows desktop.
Persisted Google Drive desktop OAuth credentials in FlutterSecureStorage for automatic background token refresh.
Added _showEditInvoiceNumberDialog with live duplicate validation to mobile sales screen.
Filtered out deleted sales in _highestSavedInvoiceNumber to prevent sequence lockouts.
Prioritized stored sequence counter in getNextInvoiceNumber to honor manual setting changes.
Pre-filled default admin username on Desktop LoginScreen and added helpful indicator.
Allowed fast-track admin login when App Lock / Startup Password is disabled in Settings.
Synchronized release metadata across Windows and Android to Build 297.
